complete_examples.text: The “rain flow” counting method is adopted to describe the stress cycles of the hazard area of the clips, and the S-N curve is used to predict the fatigue life of the clips.

Numerous experiments and theoretical studies have shown that the fatigue of fastener clips is caused by the deterioration of wheel-rail forces due to the degradation of track irregularities [13-17] and the polygonal wear of the wheel [14, 18-20], because of the irregularity of wheel-rail contact plane resulting in excessive high-frequency stress cycles.
